{{Quote|They have only themselves to blame.|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]|<ref name="CotJ" />}}
The '''Atravis Sector Massacres''' were a series of attacks<ref name="AGSWU3" /> carried out by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="CotJ" /> The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] contained the [[Atravis systems]], a group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] whose [[Planet/Legends|planets]] were devastated by the attacks.<ref name="AGSWU3" /> During the massacres, the [[Atravis system/Legends|Atravis system]] suffered extensive civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Atravis Sector Massacres lasted for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and were characterized by active hostilities between pro-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] resistance groups and [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]], who failed to put aside their differences to fight the Galactic Empire together.<ref name="TEGtW" />

The Atravis Sector Massacres were considered one of the most frightful retaliations of the Galactic Empire. At some point, [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] stated that the massacres there were actually the fault of their victims.<ref name="CotJ" /> By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had seen what the Galactic Empire had left of the Atravis systems after the attacks.<ref name="CotJ" />
